name: MaskGaussian
definition: A method that models 3D Gaussians as probabilistic entities rather than permanently removing them, utilizing them according to their probability of existence to mitigate sub-optimized reconstruction from deterministic pruning.
summary: MaskGaussian is a differentiable pruning method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses masked rasterization to allow gradients to flow to inactive Gaussians, preventing sub-optimal reconstruction caused by early pruning.
